overall_summary: Data shows low sample sizes across the board, but 'self respect' combined with common digital interactions (chats, status lists, pinned conversations) yields relatively higher view counts (35-41 views) compared to abstract emotional topics like 'रात के ख्याल' or general 'बेवफाई' (5-18 views). Confidence is low due to sparse engagement (likes/comments are almost zero), meaning we are optimizing strictly for initial impression click-through via relatable micro-habits.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on self-respect tied to smartphone mechanics (deleting chats, changing status lists, muting pinned chats) like AfaLxMy6FMY (40 views) and rwOUYo_hayQ (41 views) outperform abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks and scenarios strictly on modern, highly relatable smartphone UI or digital micro-interactions related to letting go.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'रात के ख्याल' (uIbMpCjVutQ) and general loneliness/sadness with generic phrasing get very low views (5-12 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid vague melancholic imagery like cold tea or late-night stars; anchor every emotion to a concrete, physical action or device screen.
